text:
Alex H: FYI PR #10482 (service-auth) is hitting long CI runs because integration jobs are missing caches — full build ~45m. There's a deploy freeze starting tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Can we prioritize getting this merged before the freeze or get a fast rerun with cache warm? cc @Maria L @Ben K

ci-bot: Job 4321 failed on integration:auth-suite — flakes + missing cache layers (cache key mismatch). Logs: `Checksum mismatch for deps.tar.gz` — https://ci.example.com/builds/4321

Maria L: Ugh. Is the cache key change from the new Dockerfile layers? If so we could do a manual warm run to populate the cache for this PR only. How long would that take?

Ben K: We have a small rebase window today 14:00-16:00 PT. If Alex can get a warm-run started earlier we can try to land during that window. Otherwise we'll have to wait until next window to avoid stepping on the freeze. @Sam I can infra spin up a temp agent?

Sam I: I can allocate a dedicated warm agent for one-off jobs. Need the job ID + a note saying `pre-merge-cache-warm`. I'll approve up to 2 warm runs. Ping me here once you start.

Alex H: Thanks — I'll trigger a targeted warm job now and post the job URL. Command I'm running:

```bash
ci run --job integration --matrix=auth-suite --cache=warm --notes "pre-merge-cache-warm PR#10482"
```

Alex H: kicked off warm job 4330 (https://ci.example.com/builds/4330). ETA ~12m to populate caches, then I'll rerun the full matrix.

ci-bot: Job 4330 started on warm-agent-07. Estimated duration: 10-15m.

Maria L: Nice, thanks. If the warm run fixes it, Ben can you queue the PR for the 14:00 PT rebase window? We'll need 1 approver + green CI.

Ben K: Yep. I'll reserve a slot in the window and keep eyes. If it's green by 15:30 PT we try to land. If not, we hold for next window to avoid touching freeze. :thumbsup:

Alex H: Warm run finished and cache looks populated. Kicking full matrix rerun now (job 4331). If anything fails I'll post logs. Otherwise I'll ping when green.

ci-bot: Job 4331 in progress (full integration matrix).

Alex H: Quick note for triage later — we should add a cache-key test to the CI smoke job to catch Docker layer key changes earlier. Filing a follow-up issue.

Ben K: Agreed. Follow-up issue helps avoid future last-minute warms. Thanks all.
